definitions.explanation: Fighting techniques and combat methods, encompassing both traditional Japanese martial disciplines and martial arts more broadly. Emphasizes the practical techniques of fighting.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧ emphasizes the spiritual and philosophical 'way' (⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧) of martial training (e.g., ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧, ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧). {武術|ぶじゅつ} emphasizes practical fighting techniques (⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ = technique). ⟦{武芸|ぶげい}→武芸：13243_bugei⟧ emphasizes martial skills as a cultured accomplishment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武術|ぶじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧: martial arts practice
- {武術|ぶじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn martial arts
- {武術|ぶじゅつ}⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: martial arts tournament
- {古|こ}{武術|ぶじゅつ}: classical martial arts (kōbujutsu)
